- **fse** (certified, manifest `core`): Certified core full-site-editing profile for block themes, templates, template parts, navigation, reusable blocks, and theme taxonomies. Versions: WordPress bundle.environment_summary.wordpress.

## Explicit unsupported boundaries

- **acf** — `deletions.*` / `delete`: No ACF-specific deletion selector is declared.
- **contact-form-7** — `deletions.*` / `delete`: No Contact Form 7 deletion selector is declared.
- **core** — `multisite` / `all`: The v1 contract refuses WordPress multisite before policy load or mutation.
- **core** — `unclassified.*` / `capture`: Unknown whole-entity and field surfaces remain loud pending items.
- **elementor** — `deletions.*` / `delete`: No Elementor deletion selector is declared.
- **ninja-forms** — `tables.nf3_forms` / `delete`: The shipped nf3_actions.parent_id and nf3_fields.parent_id columns have no complete indexes, so an unmodified Ninja Forms target cannot provide the next-key/gap-lock boundary required for race-safe form deletion.
- **ninja-forms** — `post_types.nf_sub` / `capture`: Submission entities are runtime-sovereign and intentionally excluded.
- **paid-memberships-pro** — `tables.pmpro_discount_codes` / `capture`: Intent marker only; no implemented typed snapshot contract.
- **paid-memberships-pro** — `tables.pmpro_discount_codes_levels` / `capture`: Intent marker only; no implemented typed snapshot contract.
- **paid-memberships-pro** — `tables.pmpro_groups` / `capture`: Intent marker only; no implemented typed snapshot contract.
- **paid-memberships-pro** — `tables.pmpro_membership_levels_groups` / `capture`: Intent marker only; no implemented typed snapshot contract.
- **paid-memberships-pro** — `tables.pmpro_memberships_categories` / `capture`: Intent marker only; no implemented typed snapshot contract.
- **paid-memberships-pro** — `production` / `promote`: No exact version/evidence contract exists.
- **polylang** — `deletions.*` / `delete`: No Polylang deletion selector is declared.
- **the-events-calendar** — `production` / `promote`: No exact version/evidence contract exists.
- **woocommerce** — `post_types.product` / `delete`: Product reverse references can live in downloads, subscriptions, order metadata, serialized values, and extension-owned custom tables that the v1 guard grammar cannot close safely.
- **woocommerce** — `post_types.product_variation` / `delete`: Variation reverse references and parent/group relationships share the same open WooCommerce extension boundary as products.
- **woocommerce** — `tables.woocommerce_attribute_taxonomies` / `delete`: The v1 guard/cascade grammar cannot express WooCommerce global-attribute semantic deletion.
- **woocommerce** — `tables.woocommerce_shipping_zone_locations|woocommerce_shipping_zone_methods|woocommerce_shipping_zones|woocommerce_tax_rate_locations|woocommerce_tax_rates` / `delete`: Shipping-zone and tax-rate rows require version-pinned WooCommerce API, cache, child-row, and option-name effects that are not a closed semantic delete contract.
- **woocommerce** — `derived.wc_category_lookup` / `apply`: WooCommerce 11.0.0 exposes only a public whole-catalog category lookup rebuild; automatic bounded repair and verification are unavailable, so operators must repair this derived table explicitly.
- **woocommerce** — `tables.runtime` / `capture`: Orders, customers, sessions, stock reservations, and Action Scheduler rows remain runtime-sovereign.
- **yoast** — `deletions.*` / `delete`: No Yoast-specific deletion selector is declared.
